messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use the video that was the input to the first hairstyle change as the starting point, and make the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands still, then raises both arms overhead and turns their body in a slow spin before returning to the original standing pose.","camera":"Static full-body shot at a low angle, keeping the subject centered against the background.","clothing":"White sleeveless tank top with a faded pink and yellow graphic, pink shorts with white trim, and pink sneakers with white laces and soles.","hair_color":"Bright red.","hairstyle":"Short, spiky hair swept upward.","identity":"A slim, light-skinned person with a short, spiky red hairstyle and a small earring, shown in full body.","scene":"An outdoor paved area under a concrete overpass or bridge, with a metal railing, green foliage, and a construction crane visible in the background under a bright sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a cobblestone street with ornate buildings to an outdoor paved area beneath a concrete overpass with a metal railing, foliage, and a construction crane, matching the reference. The person's red hair, outfit, and dance-like arm-raising/spin action remain largely consistent, and the lighting now shows stronger directional sunlight and shadows consistent with the new scene.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original street scene with the reference environment under a concrete overpass, while preserving the person's identity, red spiky hair, clothing, expression, action, and camera framing, and adapt the person's lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Whether the camera framing and movement were fully preserved despite the apparent crop difference.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear more vertically cropped than the source, changing the visible framing around the subject.
